title: Jacked Smoky Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and adventurous Irish stew featuring smoky paprika and a touch of tempering chocolate, all in a malty, tender broth.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Look for lamb with a good amount of marbling for maximum flavor.

ingredients.name: onion, chopped
ingredients.notes: A sweet onion like Vidalia or Georgia works well.

ingredients.name: carrot, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Use a variety like Nantes or Danver for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: potato, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-starch variety like Russet or Idaho.

ingredients.name: smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: This gives the stew its signature smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: chocolate, chopped
ingredients.notes: Bittersweet or dark chocolate works best.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use a high-protein flour for the best results.

ingredients.name: Guinness stout
ingredients.notes: This gives the stew a rich, malty flavor.

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for the best results.

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.notes: A full-bodied red wine like Cabernet Sauvignon works well.

ingredients.name: fresh thyme
ingredients.notes: Use fresh thyme for the best flavor.

instructions: Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set it aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, flour, and chocolate to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Guinness stout, chicken broth, and red wine to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook until the lamb is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
